Butyloctyl salicylate.class: Salicylate ester (2-butyloctyl ester of salicylic acid; C12 branched alcohol).

Polyester-8.class: Polyester (adipic acid/neopentyl glycol) end-capped with 2-cyano-3,3-diphenylacrylate (the octocrylene chromophore); NICNAS chemical name includes '2-octyldodecyl ester, 2-cyano-3,3-diphenyl-2-propenoate'.

Ethylhexyl methoxycrylene.class: Alkoxy crylene: 2-cyano-3,3-diphenylacrylate with a methoxy substituent (methoxy analog of octocrylene).

Diethylhexyl syringylidenemalonate.class: Benzylidene (syringylidene) malonate diester with a hindered phenol (antioxidant).
related: Polysilicone-15 (dimethicodiethylbenzalmalonate) - non-US filter, same benzalmalonate chromophore class

Ethyl ferulate.class: Hydroxycinnamate ester (ethyl ester of ferulic acid).
related: Octinoxate, amiloxate, cinoxate (cinnamates) - same cinnamate chromophore family (structural inference)
Is itself a US active since Aug 9, 2026
Same benzotriazole class as drometrizole trisiloxane and bisoctrizole (non-US filters)
None in US monograph; same benzalmalonate chromophore as DESM
Oxybenzone, dioxybenzone, sulisobenzone (benzophenone family - loose structural relation)
Ecamsule / terephthalylidene dicamphor sulfonic acid (camphor family; not a US monograph active)

Methylene bis-benzotriazolyl tetramethyl.class: Benzotriazole UV filter (bisoctrizole, Tinosorb M); EU Annex VI entries 23/23a (checked 2026-10-26).
